g.text: The 80% interval covers 59% to 79% of injections, and 2% under cloud load

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Share of held-out injections whose injected capacity lies inside the 80% interval from the 10th and 90th percentiles of the other four farms' recoveries. Same-year calibration: the other farms in the same season-year (12 recoveries). All-years calibration: the other farms in every season-year. Grey band: the 70% to 90% that the plan accepts. Pooled: all five decision Primaries.'
text.tspan: Share of held-out injections whose injected capacity lies inside the 80% interval from the 10th and 90th percentiles of the
other four farms' recoveries. Same-year calibration: the other farms in the same season-year (12 recoveries). All-years
calibration: the other farms in every season-year. Grey band: the 70% to 90% that the plan accepts. Pooled: all five decision
